level1Hint1: Point the lighthouse beam at the ships. They start at the far left side of the map.
level1Hint2: If the ship is too long in the dark, it will wander off course.
level1Hint3: Ships on the upper left corner show your lives, number on the upper right corner shows how many ships you have saved.
level1Hint4: Point the beam at the small mirror beacon and click it
level1Hint5: You can chain the beacons together to redirect the beam further
level1Hint6: You can break the chain by clicking the previous beacon or pressing right mouse button
scrollHint: Mouse scroll wheel can be used to zoom in and out in the map
cannonHint1: Click on the cannon to activate it
cannonHint2: Shoot the cannon at pirate ships with left mouse button
cannonHint3: Use the beacon or sonar pulse to reveal the pirate ships before shooting at them
sonarHint: Press Space to send out a sonar pulse.
